The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for different language models and their fine-tuned versions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2<sup>0</sup> to 2<sup>8</sup>, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, with tick labels at 0.2 intervals. There are four data series represented as lines with markers. The "Llama-3B" series is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers; it starts at approximately 0.42 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and increases to approximately 0.78 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>. The "Llama-3B + FT" series is represented by a dashed green line with square markers; it starts at approximately 0.38 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and increases to approximately 0.75 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>. The "Llama-1B" series is represented by a solid light blue line with triangular markers; it starts at approximately 0.32 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and increases to approximately 0.72 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>. The "Llama-1B + FT" series is represented by a dashed light green line with diamond markers; it starts at approximately 0.30 when the number of completions is 2<sup>0</sup> and increases to approximately 0.68 when the number of completions is 2<sup>8</sup>.
